abilities.name: Heart to Heart
abilities.description: Once between rests, when making a Love skill check, you may spend 4 Hope to add your Love rank to the roll.

abilities.name: Open Heart
abilities.description: Heart to Heart no longer costs Hope to use.

abilities.name: Endless Compassion
abilities.description: Heart to Heart is no longer limited to once between rests. You may use it as many times as you like.

abilities.name: Comforting Presence
abilities.description: Once between rests, you may grant temporary HP equal to your Love rank to one target of your choice, including yourself.

abilities.name: Universal Empathy
abilities.description: Heart to Heart now applies to all skill checks, not just Love skill checks.

abilities.name: Healing Wind
abilities.description: Once per round, you may spend 8 Hope to heal all allied Digimon and Tamers within 6 spaces of you for 1d12 plus your Love rank. This is not limited beyond once per round, so it can be used again and again as long as you have the Hope to pay for it.
